title: Testimonial Wall — Animated React Component — Planes
desc: A wall of customer quotes in columns that drift up and down at slightly different speeds and fade out at the edges, with each column pausing under the cursor.

Use cases

  • Landing page social proof

    A wall of quotes between features and pricing that keeps moving without asking for attention.

  • Launch and waitlist pages

    Early-user feedback that looks full even with a handful of quotes.

  • Review roundups

    Star ratings and short reviews in one section people can pause by hovering or with the Pause button.
